something to say. Now, what should I do—"

text_block_list.text: Yet it is a diamond marred by flaws.

text_block_list.text:

much?

text_block_list.text:
"If I am to offer it, it must be pure, 
clear... and perfect."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Otherwise—... it could not be called love.
